nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult woman from <Picture 1>. Same face, same hair, same appearance as in <Picture 1>, lying on a bed, her head resting against her hand, the white satin sheet draped across her chest and shoulders exactly as in <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is the dim bedroom from <Picture 1>: the lamp on the left, the dark headboard and pillow on the right, the white bed sheets.
<Picture 1> is the source for her face, hair, pose, framing and lighting.

summary:
[reference generation] Raw selfie video of <Subject 1> for an Instagram story, filmed in real time at normal speed like a real phone video. She lies in bed with her head against her hand, holds a pouty stare, slowly runs her fingers through her hair, then gives a faint closed-lip smile. Intimate, tired, confident attitude, natural and imperfect. The frame has the constant light, imperfect movement of a selfie held at arm's length.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (throughout): fully_preserved - exact face, hair and appearance from <Picture 1>. The satin sheet stays exactly in place the whole time, nothing slips, shifts, opens or gets adjusted, nothing new is revealed.
<Subject 2> (throughout): fully_preserved - same room, lamp, headboard and bed, nothing added or moved.
<Picture 1> (lighting, color, rendering): fully_preserved - keep the exact dim, warm, low-light look and the raw, grainy smartphone rendering of <Picture 1>, no extra polish or beauty filter, no brightening of the room.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Opens on the exact pose and framing of <Picture 1>: close selfie from slightly low, lying in bed, her head resting against her hand, pouty relaxed expression, eyes on the camera. Real-time speed throughout, natural human pace, NOT slow motion. The frame is never locked: it constantly drifts, shifts up and down by a few pixels and tilts a few degrees left and right, with small natural micro-jitters from an arm held out in front of her, at normal speed. The distance to her stays constant, no push-in, no zoom, no cuts. Her face stays in the frame at all times.
Movement style: like a real girl filming herself in bed at night, not a model posing. Short, casual, irregular movements, natural breathing visible in the shoulders, rare normal-speed blinks (one blink about every 3 seconds, never several in a row, eyes never stay closed). Her head makes only small natural movements of a few degrees, never thrown back, no nodding, no bobbing, no sudden jerks. Her long fine hair moves lightly and naturally with her hand and head, thin strands, no stiff hair.
Gaze for the whole video: her eyes stay on the camera lens at all times, never looking away, never to the side.
Expression: relaxed, pouty, tired and unimpressed, like in <Picture 1>, but alive, not a frozen mask. No big smile, no squinting, no puffed cheeks, no scrunched nose. Only in the last segment does a faint, relaxed smile appear, lips closed.

0:00-0:02 She holds the pouty stare into the camera, eyes open, no blinking at the very start, tiny natural head micro-movements, natural breathing. The frame drifts slowly to the right with a slight tilt of a few degrees.

0:02-0:04 The hand against her temple slides back slowly through her hair, fingers running through the strands at a normal, casual speed, pushing the hair back at her temple. A single natural blink. The frame dips slightly and shifts back to the left.

0:04-0:05.5 She continues lightly touching her hair with her fingertips. Her head tilts a few degrees into her hand. Her lips stay relaxed and pouty. The frame tilts a few degrees to one side and then corrects itself.

0:05.5-0:07 Her hand settles again against her head. Her lips close and a faint, relaxed smile appears on her closed lips, no squinting, no raised or puffed cheeks, eyes still on the camera. She stays in this pose until the last frame, the handheld drift continuing gently. The final frame is clearly different from the first frame.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet bedroom room tone, a soft breath, subtle sheet rustle, light hair movement.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
